description: Four tiny separate dry autumn leaves spread over a transparent 48x64 canvas. Each leaf is a simple three-to-five-pixel curled shape in dull brown, taupe or faded burgundy. Sparse arrangement at different heights with lots of empty space. No branches, tree, window, ground, forest or background. Strict native one-pixel-grid pixel art for DREAMS, a dark abandoned fast-food restaurant at 320x180 native resolution. Effect only, transparent background, hard opaque pixel clusters, limited supplied palette. No anti-aliasing, gradients, dithering, blur, glow, drawn background lighting, characters, text, furniture or other objects. Static camera and fixed canvas; no zoom or global position/scale jitter. Canvas exactly 48x64 pixels.

reference_images.usage_description: Native pixel density and flat pixel rendering only. Create the requested different VFX, not this steam shape.
